delivery: Local only; no cloud upload, remote push or main merge.
change: Separate Hong Kong rental property assessment with per-income property deductions, automatic statutory allowance, saved-fact reconciliation, sourced result and reopen flow. Salary and rental schedules cannot be silently assessed as sole-proprietor profits.

github_research.use: Design reference for separation of policy formulas and regression tests; no copied code or dependency adoption.

limits: Property entries require confirmed sole ownership and complete consideration; joint ownership, property business and personal assessment remain separate work.
Prior-year irrecoverable-rent relief is not calculated. Excess current-property deductions are rejected rather than offset against unrelated properties.
Property result excludes next-year provisional tax and is before assessment rounding.
Browser uses fixture authentication; actual business and real-account acceptance remain unproven.
The earlier 22-case availability inventory is historical and does not cover this newly added rental policy.
